ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 4:1 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-gray) to low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Irregular, high-contrast dark-pixel cluster centrally located around the median notch and extending toward the peduncle; the remaining lateral lobe surfaces are predominantly high-intensity white with localized low-intensity mottling at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation with a pixel-measured angle of approximately 72 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by irregular pixel-level peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex geometric curve fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes, terminating in tapered, slightly posterior-pointing distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular jaggedness and small-scale indentations along the trailing edge profile, visible as disruptions to a smooth linear curve.
